name: One real joint programme appears under each actual destination without duplicates
description: Focused deterministic journey; explicit reusable Python assertions are stored alongside this authored plan. Isolated labelled fixtures only for source mutations.

planSteps.description: Navigate to /scholarships; search GLOCAL. Select destination Germany (DE), choose all application windows and click Apply filters.
Assert exactly one GLOCAL joint programme result. Reload and assert the search and Germany filter persist. Capture its scholarship link.

Repeat for United Kingdom GB, Spain ES, Sweden SE, Colombia CO, Japan JP and Netherlands NL; assert each shows exactly the same scholarship link once. Capture and compare each literal internal href, not a destination filter URL; missing comparisons must fail. Catalogue officialUrl must be https://globallocal-erasmusmundus.eu/about-glocal/programme-overview/ under every destination.

Open that link; assert participating institutions include University of Glasgow, Kyoto University and Universidad de Los Andes. Inspect official evidence. Each of the seven study-location Scholarship information links must have the identical literal href https://globallocal-erasmusmundus.eu/about-glocal/programme-overview/ without query parameters or fragments. Funding evidence and the separate application guidance may use their specific official pages.
